Dear Sir/ Madam, 
This is in continuation to our letter dated 23 May, 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 
30(6) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 
(“the Listing Regulations”) read with Para A of Part A of Schedule Il of the Listing 
Regulations, we wish to inform that the Management of the Company participated in 
'Trinity India 2026, an Investor Conference, organized by 360 ONE Capital (B&K) on 
Friday, 29" May, 2026 at Hotel Grand Hyatt, Mumbai and met several Analysts/ 
Institutional Investors thereat. 
Information available in the public domain only was discussed and no Unpublished Price 
Sensitive Information was shared in the meetings. 
Thanking you, 
Yours faithfully, 
FOR VARDHMAN TEXTILES LIMITED
